strengths: Huge single-target burst from range
Hard to pin down: W disengages, and E pushes enemies back and cuts damage from outside its radius by up to 80%
Strong self-heal (D)
weaknesses: Often out of range of team buffs

name: Rainbow R.
description: Ranged damage dealer.
If setup around INT-based items/stats, can also be utilized as a healer that excels in small parties.
overview: Fights alongside drones (D) that join the attacks and can attach to allies. All skill damage uses Magitek affinity, which equals 70% of the highest elemental affinity.

statNotes.AGI: Ranged damage dealer with some healing on the side.
statNotes.INT: Healer that bounces heals between allies, breaks shields with E, and makes T's missiles pierce enemies and heal allies.

strengths: W shields an ally, removes debuffs and gives a speed boost
R makes the target take more damage, and E adds 4% more magic damage taken
INT excels in small parties
weaknesses: Hard to heal 3 or more players at once
Immobile

name: Shiro
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on auto-attacks.
Playstyle is simple compared to most other characters.
overview: A burst damage dealer who summons enchanted swords through attacks and skills, then spends them for bonus damage and quick dashes onto enemies. W, E and R are chants for speed, power or protection, and T extends the next chant to nearby allies.
strengths: Simple to play
Can buff allies with attack damage, speed or a cleanse and 50% damage reduction (T)
F stuns and makes the target take 50% more damage from enchanted swords

name: Lucicree
role: High Mobility with mid-ranged DoT DPS
description: Ranged damage dealer. Uses a good mix of auto attacks and skill casts.
overview: A revolver gunslinger with 6 bullets, mixing basic attacks with skills. Q tumbles and guarantees a crit on the next shot, R empties the cylinder, and T removes bullet costs and cuts cooldowns for a burst window.
strengths: Highly mobile at mid range (Q)
Shots never miss and ignore all armor
F deals extra damage to low-HP targets
weaknesses: Revolves around 30s and 15s burst windows

name: Louis Arcienne
role: High sustained damage (DoT dps), and strong stunner
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills, but it weaves auto-attacks in between skill casts.
overview: Weaves basic attacks between skills: each cast empowers the next attack for heavy damage that hits everything nearby. Q, W and E each chain into a follow-up. Finishing combos leaves illusion swords that boost AGI and can all be fired at once with R.
strengths: High sustained damage
T makes the target take 6% more damage
Stuns and knockbacks give strong crowd control
weaknesses: Damage depends on weaving basic attacks between skills

name: Dorothy de Merrian

strengths: Very durable: damage reduction, self-healing, and extra protection at low HP
Gives the party +4% Main Stat and makes enemies take 6% more damage

name: Kenneth Deracoon

strengths: Simple playstyle with very few skill casts
Lowers enemy armor by 40% and makes them take more proc damage (E)
Self-sustaining: R randomly adds attack damage, damage reduction and regen
weaknesses: Damage depends on random procs

name: Naomi Mercedes
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Provides a bit of offensive support.
overview: A spear fighter whose skills can crit. She powers up each skill with D, breaks barriers, and finishes off low-HP targets.
strengths: Breaks barriers, and E deals extra damage to low-HP targets
Makes her target take 4% more damage and gives allies she hits +6% Main Stat (T)
Self-sustaining: ki regen also heals her, and R pulls her back out of danger
weaknesses: Gets +15% damage only while her ki is above 50%
Needs D cast before skills to get their empowered effects

name: Aurelia
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Skill combos are more complex compared to other characters.
overview: A scythe fighter built around skill combos. D refreshes Q and E, W stacks extra damage for repeating the same kind of hit, and E powers up Q for a big burst. F marks a target to take more damage the lower its HP, then hits hard when the mark ends.
strengths: High burst damage
Hard to take down: R cuts damage taken by 80% with CC immunity, and T gives another 30%
Strong mobility (D and E)
weaknesses: Revolves around 15s and 30s burst windows

name: Ayame
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on casting skills.
Has stealth abilities.
overview: All skills can crit. Q and W reset each other and build marks that raise crit chance, and full marks let T fire instantly with shadows that copy the next skill. Slips into stealth when out of combat, and E turns invisible for a big opening hit.
strengths: High burst damage
Safe while hidden: 30% damage reduction in stealth, and R keeps stealth up inside the smoke
weaknesses: Short burst windows: damage drops off between T casts

Breaks shields (R)
Durable: the magnetic field adds up to 20% damage reduction, and E adds 30% more

name: Elena
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on auto attacks.
Instead of MP, she uses HP to cast skills.
overview: Pays for skills with HP and gets stronger as her HP drops. She heals on every hit and can refuse to die for a short time (T).
strengths: Simple, auto-attack-focused playstyle
At low HP: +15% damage, up to 50% damage reduction, and more attack damage
Heals 6% max HP on every basic attack
weaknesses: While her E toggle is on, she gets 85% less healing and can't go above 30% HP, so healers barely help her

name: Iris Millen
description: Ranged damage dealer.
Provides some support for allies.
overview: An elven archer whose arrows explode every few seconds and store charges, letting Q and W skip their cooldowns. A guardian scout (E) follows along, joining attacks and buffing nearby allies. T and F rain down big volleys.
strengths: Gives nearby allies +4% attack damage and Main Stat, and E's active boosts their HP regen
Strong crowd control: Q stuns, W slows, and T stuns everything it hits

statNotes.STR: +10% damage, and Sigils also amplify skill damage.
statNotes.INT: Devotion: deals 40% less damage, but gets a bigger aura, heals allies, and extends T and F protection to the party.

strengths: Flexible support: the aura can be swapped to fit the party
Strong mobility (W)

name: Harang
description: Ranged damage dealer. Focused on skill casts.
Requires constant input of keys; not recommended if you have a bad wrist.
overview: A melee fighter with slightly longer reach than most. Slashes up to 3 times in a row, ignoring armor, and spends souls for bonus damage. R dodges the next attack, refills souls and resets W and E. T removes soul costs for 6 seconds and amplifies skill damage by 12%.
strengths: High damage that keeps up through the fight
R lets a well-timed dodge restore souls and resets skills
weaknesses: High APM (actions per minute): needs constant key input, so it isn't recommended if you have wrist strain

name: The Nameless One
description: Supporter. Focused on healing skills.
overview: Every 4th attack heals the hero and two nearby allies. The highest stat decides the role.

statNotes.AGI: Damage dealer. Skills deal 100% more damage, and R costs no Ki.
statNotes.STR/INT: Healer. Activates Harmony, which boosts healing, lets Q target allies and makes enemies take more damage. Heals also give allies +2.5% final damage.

strengths: Easy to play
Easily overheals multiple people
weaknesses: Low APM (actions per minute)

name: Yue Tenebras
description: Supporter. Focused on utility skills.

name: Noface
description: Melee damage dealer. Focused on skill casts, and relies heavily on combos.
Requires constant input of keys; not recommended if you have a bad wrist.
overview: Builds combo stacks by chaining actions: repeating one (AAA) or alternating them (AWA). Changing combo types stacks up to 4 times for more attack and skill damage. Cracking and shattering enemies sets up big hits.
strengths: High damage ceiling and skill expression
Makes the target take 6% more damage (E)
F latches onto a boss and shatters it
weaknesses: High APM (actions per minute), and a failed combo resets the stacks

name: Luk
description: Melee damage dealer. Difficult as it requires controlling two characters at once.
overview: Fights alongside an illusion that copies every move. Q marks the target, and E and T consume the marks for big hits. R throws cards that can be teleported to, and F resets T for a second finisher.
strengths: High burst once marks are stacked
Highly mobile: E swaps places with the illusion, and R teleports to cards
The illusion takes 40% reduced damage, and R's teleport adds a short damage reduction
weaknesses: Hard to play: you control two characters at once

name: Mina
description: Ranged damage dealer. Has some supportive abilities.

name: Maru

overview: Spawns and collects orbs of light, turning them into stacks that power up R's charged kick. T resets basic skill cooldowns, and a fully charged T adds +25% skill damage and extra resets.
strengths: Frequent cooldown resets create big burst windows
Infinite mobility
Lots of burst range
weaknesses: Extremely high APM and repetition

name: Yuzuka
description: Ranged damage dealer. Relies greatly on attacks.
overview: A heavily armed gunner whose basic attacks burn, ignore all armor and splash. E sets up crits for the skills, and missiles load on their own and fire all at once with T.
strengths: High range
Simple to play, with a shield that builds up every second
Armor-ignoring splash attacks
weaknesses: Immobile
Gets no attack speed from AGI and only half from other sources

name: Celeste
description: Melee damage dealer. Unleashes fast combos using her sword and arcane magic.
overview: Mixes swordplay with arcane magic, with most skills scaling on STR + INT. W and R mark the target, and Q and T consume the mark for crits, resets and shield breaking.
strengths: E completely blocks the next skill hit and counters
T breaks shields on a marked target
R also heals allies
weaknesses: Damage depends on applying and consuming marks in the right order
